note: Country store and RV park at 20458 Hwy 8, about 5.6 miles southeast of I-44 Exit 195, with a swimming pool for campers (Memorial Day-Labor Day) and canoe, raft and kayak floats; trout fishing nearby. Its website is old and its rates may be out of date; call 573-265-3796. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 49 full-hookup sites, 50A/water/sewer, phone booking; added facilities (showers, restrooms, laundry, dump, store, wifi), holiday-weekend 2-night minimum and $10 deposit. Season year-round (derived) -> Mar 1-Nov 1 per the operator's page, with a dated contrary review in the note. Posted rate $24/$26 is on an old (c. 2012) page, so fees not written. Google 4.7/75, RV Life 4.5/20 $$.
